title: Grammar: Emphasis Structures — Cleft Sentences and Fronting
grammarTip:
Структуры для усиления/выделения (Emphasis structures):

CLEFT SENTENCES — выделяем нужное слово:
"It was JOHN who broke the window." (не кто-то другой — Джон)
"It is THIS PROBLEM that we need to solve." (именно эту проблему)
"What I need is MORE TIME." (то, что нужно = больше времени)
"What surprised me was HER REACTION." (что удивило = её реакция)

INVERSION для усиления:
"Not only did he fail, but he also refused to try again."
"Rarely have I seen such dedication."
"Little did she know what was waiting for her."

💡 Cleft sentences и инверсия — инструменты опытного писателя. Используй для логического ударения, не для красоты.

grammarTable.subject: It-cleft
grammarTable.example: "It is political will that we lack, not technology." / "It was the Paris Agreement that marked a turning point."

grammarTable.subject: Wh-cleft
grammarTable.example: "What we need is urgent action." / "What scientists fear most is the crossing of tipping points."

grammarTable.subject: All-cleft
grammarTable.example: "All that is required is political determination."

grammarTable.subject: Fronting
grammarTable.verb: Moving element to front of sentence
grammarTable.example: "Climate action, we cannot afford to delay." / "This crisis alone can we not ignore."

grammarTable.subject: Not…but-cleft
grammarTable.verb: It is not X but Y that…
grammarTable.short: correction emphasis — not this but that
grammarTable.example: "It is not individuals but corporations that bear the greatest responsibility."

grammarTable.subject: Inversion
grammarTable.verb: Never / Only / Not only + auxiliary + subject
grammarTable.example: "Never before has the planet warmed so rapidly." / "Only by acting now can we prevent the worst."

rows.form: It is/was + emphasis + that/who + rest of sentence
rows.example: "It is rapid decarbonisation that offers the best hope." (emphasis on "rapid decarbonisation")

rows.form: Can emphasise subject, object, or adverb
rows.example: "It was in 2015 that the Paris Agreement was signed." (emphasises the time)

rows.form: For people: use "who"; for things: use "that"
rows.example: "It was Greta Thunberg who first brought climate strikes to global attention."

rows.form: Negative it-cleft: it is not X but Y
rows.example: "It is not hope but determination that drives effective action."

rows.form: What + subject + verb + is/was + X
rows.example: "What the world needs is coordinated global action on emissions."

rows.form: Common openings: What…is; What…matters; What…shows; What…requires
rows.example: "What the data shows is an accelerating rate of warming."

rows.form: Can be reversed: X is what + subject + verb
rows.example: "Coordinated action is what the world desperately needs."

rows.form: "All that…" = only thing (more restrictive than "what")
rows.example: "All that is standing in the way is political will."

grammarExtra.title: Fronting: Moving Elements Forward for Emphasis

rows.form: Object fronted for contrast or emphasis
rows.example: "The oceans, the forests, and the atmosphere — these we are destroying at unprecedented speed."

rows.form: Adverb/adverbial fronted
rows.example: "In the Arctic, the effects of warming are most dramatic."

rows.form: Complement fronted
rows.example: "More urgent, perhaps, is the need for international financial commitments."

rows.form: Common in formal spoken and written English
rows.example: "Central to the whole debate is the question of who pays for the transition."

rows.form: Never + auxiliary + subject + verb
rows.example: "Never before has the planet warmed so rapidly in human history."

rows.form: Only + time/condition + auxiliary + subject + verb
rows.example: "Only by acting decisively can we avoid the worst consequences."

rows.form: Not only + auxiliary + subject + verb + but also
rows.example: "Not only does climate change threaten ecosystems, but it also deepens inequality."

rows.form: Rarely / Seldom / Hardly + auxiliary + subject + verb
rows.example: "Seldom have governments faced a challenge of this scale and urgency."

rows.form: ❌ It is the technology that is what we need.
rows.example: ✅ It is technology that we need. (it-cleft) OR What we need is technology. (wh-cleft)

rows.form: ❌ What we need it is global cooperation.
rows.example: ✅ What we need is global cooperation. (no "it" after "is")

rows.form: ❌ Never before the planet has warmed so rapidly.
rows.example: ✅ Never before has the planet warmed so rapidly. (inversion: auxiliary before subject)

rows.form: ❌ Only when we act, we can prevent the worst.
rows.example: ✅ Only when we act can we prevent the worst. (inversion after "only")

exercises.text: "___ government policy ___ will determine whether we achieve net zero." (emphasis on "government policy")
exercises.hint: "It is + X + that" = it-cleft emphasising "government policy"

exercises.text: "___ we lack is not technology but political will." (emphasis on "not technology but political will")
"___ has the planet experienced warming at this speed."
exercises.hint: "Never before + auxiliary + subject + verb" = dramatic negative inversion

exercises.text: "It is not individuals ___ corporations that bear the greatest historical responsibility."
exercises.hint: "It is not X but Y that…" = correction/contrast emphasis

exercises.text: "___ scientists fear most is the possibility of crossing multiple tipping points simultaneously."
exercises.hint: "What + subject + verb + is + X" = wh-cleft emphasising the feared outcome

exercises.text: "Only by reducing emissions drastically ___ ___ (we / prevent) the worst consequences of climate change."
exercises.hint: "Only by… + auxiliary + subject + verb" = inversion after "only"

exercises.text: "Central to any effective climate strategy is the pricing of carbon emissions."
exercises.hint: "Central to… is X" = complement fronted for emphasis

exercises.text: "We need international cooperation urgently." → ___ we need is international cooperation.
"Not only ___ climate change threaten biodiversity, but it also destabilises food systems."
exercises.hint: "Not only + does + subject + verb… but also" = negative inversion

exercises.text: "___ the Amazon that acts as the world's largest carbon sink." (= The Amazon does this)

opts: All that we need it is more data.
All that is required is political determination.
All what we need is more funding.
All we need it political determination.
exercises.correct: All that is required is political determination.
exercises.hint: "All that + verb + is + X" = restrictive wh-cleft ("the only thing required is…")

exercises.text: "Seldom ___ governments ___ (face) such an urgent and complex challenge simultaneously."
"What the Paris Agreement represented was a turning point in international climate diplomacy."
"International financial commitments will determine the success of the agreement." → ___ ___ financial commitments ___ will determine the success.", (emphasise "international financial commitments")

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct inversion after "only when."
exercises.text: "Only when governments act decisively ___ we prevent the worst."
exercises.hint: "Only when + clause + will + subject + verb" = inversion

exercises.instruction: Which is the most emphatic way to state the argument?
exercises.text: "Technology is not the main obstacle to climate action."
opts: Technology is not the main obstacle.
It is not technology that is the main obstacle.
Not technology is the main obstacle.
The main obstacle is not technology.
exercises.correct: It is not technology that is the main obstacle.
exercises.hint: "It is not X that…" = negative it-cleft for maximum emphasis

questions.text: "___ political will ___ is the most critical missing ingredient in climate action."
questions.hint: "It is + X + that" = it-cleft emphasising "political will"

questions.text: "___ scientists warn about most is the possibility of crossing multiple tipping points."
"___ has the need for climate action been more urgent than it is today."
questions.hint: "Never before + auxiliary + subject + verb" = negative inversion

questions.text: "It is not individuals ___ corporations that have produced the majority of global emissions."
questions.hint: "It is not X but Y that" = negative it-cleft correction

questions.text: "Only by achieving net zero by 2050 ___ we limit warming to 1.5°C."
questions.hint: "Only by… + can/will + subject + verb" = inversion after "only"

questions.text: "What we need it is global cooperation" is grammatically correct.
questions.hint: "What we need is global cooperation" — no "it" after "is" in a wh-cleft

questions.text: "___ ___ does climate change threaten biodiversity, but it also deepens global inequality." (negative inversion)
questions.hint: "Not only + does + subject + verb… but also"

questions.text: "Central to the whole debate is the question of who pays for the transition." — This uses…
questions.hint: The complement ("Central to the debate") is moved to the front

questions.text: "___ is required is not more data but more decisive action." (restrictive wh-cleft)
questions.hint: "All that + verb + is + X" = the only thing required is…

questions.text: "Seldom ___ governments faced a challenge of this scale." (inversion)
"___ ___ the 2015 Paris Agreement ___ first established legally recognised emissions targets for nearly all nations." (it-cleft, time)
questions.hint: "It was + time + that" = it-cleft emphasising when

questions.text: Which sentence correctly uses a negative it-cleft?
opts: It is not that technology lacks, but will.
It is not technology that we lack, but political will.
It not technology that is we lack.
Not it is technology that we lack.
questions.correct: It is not technology that we lack, but political will.
questions.hint: "It is not X that… but Y" = correct negative it-cleft structure
